workflow.name: Peel markers
workflow.description:
Print and cut one A4 sheet of peel markers ("PEEL THIS FIRST" pill + arrow): **35 sets a sheet**, one set per sticker (4 per Small pack, 2 per Medium, 1 per Large). SmithPackaging label sheet, Epson ET-3950, Cricut Print Then Cut.

**First print only (then delete this list):**
- [ ] Check sizes in Design Space with the lock on: pill **3.4 × 0.9cm**, arrow **1.2 × 1.4cm**. Note the project name and grid.
- [ ] Confirm the cut setting on a real label sheet: Sticker Paper, Kiss Cut, pressure Less (only tested on copy paper so far).
- [ ] Confirm the sheet gives 35 good sets.
- [ ] Decide whether stock counts in sets or sheets (output per run 35 or 1).

Full reference: `claude/Internal-Products-Workflow.md` §1.

steps.name: Artwork and layout - print
steps.instructions:
1. Open the saved peel marker project in Design Space.
2. Load **one SmithPackaging label sheet** in the printer, nothing else in the tray.
3. **Make → Send to printer**, in the same session as the cut (so the sensor marks print at the right size).
4. Print settings:
   - Use System Dialog: **On**
   - Epson paper type: **Plain Paper / Bright White**
   - Quality: **High**
   - Scale: **100%**; no fit-to-page, no borderless, no centring
   - Bleed: **On**

steps.name: Drying
steps.instructions:
- **10 minutes** on the drying tray (note the tray number).
- Flat, face up; don't stack fresh sheets.

steps.name: Cutting
steps.instructions:
**Settings**
- **Print Then Cut**, size lock on.
- Mat: **12 × 12 Light Grip**. Sheet landscape, printed arrow at top left.
- Material: **Sticker Paper**, **Kiss Cut**, pressure **Less**. Markers stay on the backing; peel one at a time when packing.

**If a cut misses**
- **Sensor can't read the marks:** check the light isn't shining straight on the mat and the sheet is flat; retry; then unload and reload.
- **Cut offset from the print:** stop, run Print Then Cut calibration (Menu → Calibration), reprint.
- **Cut through the backing:** lower the pressure.

steps.name: Quality check
steps.instructions:
**Good sheet:**
- Every pill and arrow cut through the label face; backing uncut (nothing drops out when lifted).
- Cut follows the magenta edge, no white rim.
- "PEEL THIS FIRST" sharp, no smudge or banding.
- Each marker lifts cleanly and sticks flat.

**Bin a single marker** with a white rim, torn edge, smudge or lifted corners.

**Scrap the whole sheet** if more than **5 sets** are bad, or the cut is offset across the sheet. Recalibrate before the next print.

**Log** the number of bad sets for this sheet.

steps.name: Stock and storage
steps.instructions:
- Store the cut sheets **flat** in the labelled folder, print date written on, away from sun and damp. Use the oldest first.
- **Reprint** when fewer than **12 sets** are left.
- **Reorder** SmithPackaging label sheets when fewer than **20** are left (shared with the seal sticker).
